title: Cohomological rigidity of solvable Lie algebras of maximal ran
summary: We study the second cohomology group with coefficients in the adjoint module for a class of solvable Lie algebras $\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{T}}$ that arise as maximal solvable extensions of nilpotent Lie algebras $\mathcal{N}$ of maximal rank. Under suitable structural assumptions on the root system determined by the action of a maximal torus $\mathcal{T}$ on $\mathcal{N}$, we obtain sufficient conditions for the cohomological rigidity of $\mathcal{R}_{\mathcal{T}}$.
